checkpoint_boundary.reason: ExternalSession exports append/cursor only. No complete serializer/restorer exists for HistoricalRuntime, TA/request contexts, object identities and external broker state. Output snapshots are not calculation checkpoints.
checkpoint_boundary.policy: Keep the existing fail-closed horizon and durable full transcript; do not reset state or widen history limits to mask the missing continuation contract.

limitations: Three exact bundled spot scripts replicated across independent accounts, not 1000 distinct strategies.
Only six exact source SHA256s qualify for incremental execution; other and legacy scripts replay.
40x stress: a 25ms wall clock tick advances 1000ms simulation, with 10/15/30s simulated bars.
Short in-memory durable journal load; PostgreSQL restart correctness tested separately from capacity.
Final paused backlog and simulation observation lag are not wall-clock decision P95.
No per-decision wall-clock P95 instrumentation or long-run memory/worker-recycle qualification.
Sampled summed working set counts shared pages per process and can miss short-lived processes.
Responses and durable transcript remain complete; no complete Pine calculation checkpoint.
History default512/max2048 fail-closed unchanged; upstream 0.3.2 compatibility work not integrated.
